citation: Chicago Tribune, April 25, 1882, “THE OLD SETTLERS. Deaths During the Year.” — the Calumet Club's fourth annual reception announced for 18 May, with John Wentworth's list of old settlers who had died since 1 January 1881.
author: list compiled by the Hon. John Wentworth
describes_date: deaths 1881-01-01/1882-04-11; the men themselves were Chicago residents before 1 January 1840
locator: “THE OLD SETTLERS. Deaths During the Year.” — forty names with dates of death, from “Bennett Bailey, Nov.11. 1881” to “Homer Wilimarth, March 29, 1882”
rights_note: Chicago Tribune, 1882: a United States imprint long out of copyright.
access_notes: READ THROUGH A TRANSCRIPTION, NOT AT THE PAGE. This project has not retrieved the Tribune of 25 April 1882; the text read is chicagology's reprint (chicagology_goldenage_063), and every reading taken from it is marked reading: transcription_mediated. `verified` stays false until someone opens the newspaper.
note: Wentworth kept the club's roll of old settlers and asked in print to be corrected: “If any names have been omitted, or any dates are wrong, he should be at once notified”. The list is a death roll, not an arrival list: it dates ends, not beginnings.
